title: Il Est Raconte
identity: Dia Succari’s Il est raconté is an original alto saxophone and piano work published by Alphonse Leduc. A Philharmonie de Paris saxophone reference entry supplies additional program and rhythmic information.

evidence.claim: Composer work listing identifies alto saxophone and piano, 1987, Alphonse Leduc.
A university repertoire study includes the work in its catalog of saxophone and piano pieces.
The guide describes a continuous work alternating measured and improvised sections, in a delicate 3+2+2+3 meter.
evidence.source_name: Claude Delangle et al., 10 ans avec le saxophone (Philharmonie de Paris digital scan)

review_focus: Inference from the 1993 guide: examine the transitions between measured and improvised material, maintain the compound 3+2+2+3 grouping, and coordinate varied accents. Score notation and improvisation instructions remain uninspected.
collection_flag: Original saxophone work; catalogued in a university saxophone repertoire survey. No young-player target documented.
gaps: No readable score notation, verified recording, or exact duration was located. The accessible 1993 reference provides work-specific rhythmic and structural information, but the notation and improvisation instructions were not inspected.
